items.name: video/generate
items.since: protocol v2.0 · media_token (aud executa-media) · matrix ≥ media reverse-RPC release (2026-10-08)
items.direction: Plugin → Agent → Nexus `POST /copilot/media/video/generate` → executa_media_gate → app_media_facade (origin=executa) → fal queue → R2
items.summary: Submit an async text-to-video / image-to-video job from a plugin. Same parameter space, state machine, pre-charge/refund billing and 30-min URL rule as the App Host API `video.generate`; gated by `host_capabilities: ["llm.video"]`, the user's `media_grant.video`, the `media_token` claim `allow_video` and a per-invoke job counter (`max_video_jobs`).

wire.context: Agent injects `params.context = {invoke_id, media_token}` automatically — plugins never fill it.

items.signature:
python: host.video.generate(*, prompt: str, image_url: str | None = None, duration_sec: int | None = None, resolution: str | None = None, aspect_ratio: str | None = None, generate_audio: bool | None = None, model: str | None = None, client_tag: str | None = None) -> dict  ·  host.video.generate_await(..., poll_interval_s=5, timeout_s=600) -> dict
node: host.video.generate({...}) / generateAwait(...)  ·  go: media.Client.Generate / GenerateAwait

params.name: durationSec / resolution / aspectRatio / generateAudio / model / clientTag
params.summary: Identical semantics and catalogue validation to the App surface (see `video.generate`).

returns.desc: Poll with `video/get_job` (plugins have no event channel) — the SDK `generate_await` helper does adaptive polling for you.

errors.name: VIDEO_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `host_capabilities` lacks `llm.video`, `media_grant.video.enabled` is off, token claim `allow_video` false, or the Executa is disabled.

errors.name: VIDEO_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: CU pre-charge failed (user plan quota).

errors.name: VIDEO_CONCURRENCY_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Per-invoke Redis counter exhausted (`media_token` claim `max_video_jobs`, default **2**) — too many video jobs inside one tool invocation. Reservation is rolled back.

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Parameter outside the model's catalogue space; `data.allowed` echoes it.

errors.name: VIDEO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: fal submit failed; hold refunded.

errors.name: VIDEO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No routable video model / bad hint.

errors.name: VIDEO_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: Moderation rejected the request; not billed.

billing.model: pre-charge → settle / refund (same as App surface); per-invoke cap `max_video_jobs` (default 2) tracked in Redis `media:invoke:{tool_invoke_id}` for 30 min → `VIDEO_CONCURRENCY_EXCEEDED`

items.example:
# python executa_sdk
result = host.video.generate_await(
    prompt="Slow dolly-in on a rain-soaked neon street",
    duration_sec=5, resolution="768p", aspect_ratio="16:9",
    metadata={"executa_invoke_id": ctx.invoke_id},
)
url = result["result"]["url"]        # ~30 min TTL — host/uploadFile for durable storage
limitations: No push events on the plugin side — poll `video/get_job`.
Result URL ~30 min; re-`get_job` re-signs. Per-invoke job cap (`VIDEO_CONCURRENCY_EXCEEDED`) is separate from (and in addition to) the user's CU quota.

items.name: video/get_job
items.since: protocol v2.0 · media_token (aud executa-media) · matrix ≥ media reverse-RPC release (2026-10-08)
items.summary: Authoritative job view (same `JobView` shape as the App surface). Re-signs an expired `result.url`.

wire.context: Agent injects `params.context = {invoke_id, media_token}` automatically — plugins never fill it.

errors.name: VIDEO_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `host_capabilities` lacks `llm.video`, `media_grant.video.enabled` is off, token claim `allow_video` false, or the Executa is disabled.

errors.name: VIDEO_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown or not owned by this user / plugin.

limitations: Poll adaptively (SDK default 5s); avoid tight loops — each call is a reverse RPC round trip.

items.name: video/cancel_job
items.since: protocol v2.0 · media_token (aud executa-media) · matrix ≥ media reverse-RPC release (2026-10-08)
items.summary: Cancel a queued job (full refund) or attempt to cancel a running one (no refund if already rendering).

wire.context: Agent injects `params.context = {invoke_id, media_token}` automatically — plugins never fill it.

returns.type: { jobId, state: 'cancelled', refunded: true } | { jobId, state: 'running', cancelPending: false }

errors.name: VIDEO_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `host_capabilities` lacks `llm.video`, `media_grant.video.enabled` is off, token claim `allow_video` false, or the Executa is disabled.

errors.name: VIDEO_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown job.

errors.name: VIDEO_JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE
errors.desc: Already terminal.

items.name: audio/speak
items.since: protocol v2.0 · media_token (aud executa-media) · matrix ≥ media reverse-RPC release (2026-10-08)
items.direction: Plugin → Agent → Nexus `POST /copilot/media/audio/speak` → executa_media_gate → app_media_facade.audio_speak (origin=executa) → TTS provider → R2 / inline
items.summary: Synchronous TTS from a plugin — same parameters, voice/length validation and model resolution as the App `audio.speak`; gated by `host_capabilities: ["llm.audio.speak"]`, `media_grant.audio.{enabled, speak}`, token claim `allow_audio_speak` and a per-invoke character budget (`max_audio_chars`, default 8000).

wire.context: Agent injects `params.context = {invoke_id, media_token}` automatically — plugins never fill it.

items.signature: host.audio.speak(*, text: str, voice: str | None = None, language: str | None = None, speed: float | None = None, format: str = 'mp3', timestamps: bool = False, delivery: str = 'url', model: str | None = None, timeout: int = 120) -> dict

params.name: text
params.summary: ≤ model `maxCharsPerCall`; also counted against the per-invoke `max_audio_chars` budget.

params.name: voice / language / speed / format / timestamps / delivery / model

returns.type: { url?, expiresIn?, audioBase64?, mimeType, charCount, billedCostCU, model }

errors.name: AUDIO_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: Missing `llm.audio.speak` capability / grant / token claim, or Executa disabled.

errors.name: AUDIO_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User CU quota exhausted.

errors.name: AUDIO_TEXT_TOO_LONG
errors.desc: Over the model cap (`data.allowed.maxCharsPerCall`), **or** the per-invoke `max_audio_chars` budget (default 8000) is exhausted — message says `per-invoke audio chars exceeded: {n}/{cap}` and the reservation is rolled back.

errors.name: AUDIO_VOICE_INVALID
errors.desc: Unknown voice (`data.allowed` lists valid ids).

errors.name: AUDIO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No TTS model routable.

errors.name: AUDIO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Provider failure.

billing.model: per character after success; per-invoke reservation in Redis `media:invoke:{tool_invoke_id}.audio_chars` (claim `max_audio_chars`, default 8000) → `AUDIO_TEXT_TOO_LONG`

items.example:
out = host.audio.speak(text="Rendering complete.", format="mp3",  # voice omitted → model default
                       metadata={"executa_invoke_id": ctx.invoke_id})
play(out["url"])
limitations: Non-streaming only; realtime ASR/TTS for Apps is the `anna.audio.session` design (PB2+), not a plugin surface.

items.name: audio/transcribe
items.since: protocol v2.0 · media_token (aud executa-media) · matrix ≥ 2026-10-12 (`METHOD_AUDIO_TRANSCRIBE`) · nexus 1.1.0-beta.189
items.direction: Plugin → Agent → Nexus `POST /copilot/media/audio/transcribe` → executa_media_gate._gate_audio_transcribe → app_media_facade.audio_transcribe (request_type=EXECUTA_STT) → STT provider
items.summary: Synchronous STT (≤ 10 min) from a plugin — 1:1 mirror of the App `audio.transcribe` contract under `audio/speak`'s security model; gated by `host_capabilities: ["llm.audio.transcribe"]`, `media_grant.audio.{enabled, transcribe}`, token claim `allow_audio_transcribe` and a per-invoke seconds budget (`max_audio_seconds`, default 600).

wire.context: Agent injects `params.context = {invoke_id, media_token}` automatically — plugins never fill it.

items.signature: host.audio.transcribe(*, audio_bytes: bytes | None = None, audio_url: str | None = None, format: str = 'wav', language: str | None = None, model: str | None = None, timeout: int = 90) -> dict

params.name: audioBase64
params.summary: Inline audio, base64, ≤ 10 MB decoded. Exactly one of `audioBase64` / `audioUrl`. SDKs base64-encode `audio_bytes` for you.

params.name: audioUrl
params.summary: Public `https://` URL, ≤ 25 MB, SSRF-guarded; format taken from Content-Type.

params.name: language / model
params.summary: Language hint (echoed back; default auto) and optional STT model hint.

returns.type: { text, durationSec, durationExact, language, billedCostCU, model }
returns.desc: `durationSec` is exact for `wav` (header) and a byte-based estimate otherwise (`durationExact=false`). `model` echoes the resolved STT model.

errors.name: AUDIO_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: Missing `llm.audio.transcribe` capability / `media_grant.audio.transcribe` / token claim, Executa disabled — or host too old (`method_not_found` mapped by SDKs).

errors.name: AUDIO_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: User CU quota exhausted.

errors.name: AUDIO_TOO_LONG
errors.desc: > 10 MB inline, > 25 MB URL, or > 600 s (`wav`, exact). `data.allowed` carries the cap.

errors.name: AUDIO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: STT provider failure or `audioUrl` fetch failure.

errors.name: AUDIO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No STT model routable.

errors.name: AUDIO_INVOKE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: Per-invoke seconds budget exhausted — message `per-invoke audio seconds exceeded: {n}/{cap}`; the reservation is rolled back.

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Neither / both of `audioBase64` + `audioUrl`, bad base64, or missing / unknown `format` for inline audio.

billing.model: per audio second after success; per-invoke reservation in Redis `media:invoke:{tool_invoke_id}.audio_seconds` (claim `max_audio_seconds`, default 600; wav estimated exactly, other formats 25 s/MB, settled to real `durationSec`) → `AUDIO_INVOKE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`

limitations: Non-streaming only — stdio has no audio-stream semantics; realtime ASR is the App-side `anna.audio.session` design.
Inline cap 10 MB (~5 min of 16 kHz mono wav); use `audioUrl` or chunk for longer recordings.
Duration is exact only for `wav`; the 600 s cap is enforced exactly for `wav` and by byte caps otherwise.
